ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white zones are localized at the distal tips and along the anterior (leading) edges. Low-intensity dark pigmentation dominates the central and posterior regions, with high-frequency mottling and speckling observed at the transition zones between light and dark fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 60 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Distinguishable saw-tooth peaks are prominent on the medial section of the right lobe, while the left lobe exhibits more rounded, wave-like amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve exhibiting concave curvature near the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep mid-lobe, and terminating in a slight concave taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (5-12 pixels in diameter) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of vertical and sub-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the dark pigment regions, particularly prevalent on the left lobe's medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks across the central fluke surface; irregular, jagged erosion at the distal tips suggesting previous physical trauma or epibiont shedding.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical serration profile on the trailing edge, featuring a distinct, deep indentation on the inner right lobe relative to the left lobe's smoother contour.
